goal.objective: Build and independently verify the dependency-free Triage Board through a visible V12 IDE run.

assumptions.statement: A current Chromium browser and browser local storage are available.
assumptions.rationale: The bounded dogfood target is a local desktop application.

assumptions.statement: The external host supplies native subagents and enforces the compiled boundaries.
assumptions.rationale: Runtime supply and enforcement remain outside the V12 kernel.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Domain and persistence behavior is implemented with deterministic evidence.

evidenceRequirements.description: Produce domain and persistence implementation plus passing unit tests.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The integrated application is tested and independently reviewed.

evidenceRequirements.description: Produce the integrated controller, runnable example, and combined verification.
Independently review the complete integrated application and execution evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The semantic responsive interface is implemented with inspectable evidence.

evidenceRequirements.description: Produce the semantic HTML and responsive CSS interface.

forbiddenEffects: Do not access a network, secret, external service, or undeclared repository path.
Do not change the product specification or application contract.
Do not install dependencies, mutate Git, merge, or update durable memory.
